model_annotation: This plot compares two metrics—labeled 中介语网络 (interlanguage network) and 随机网络 (random network)—across seven categorical levels displayed on the x-axis: A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2, and 母语 (native language), arranged from left to right. The y-axis is on a linear scale ranging from 3.0 to 5.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5, and no explicit unit label is provided. The red line with triangle markers represents 中介语网络; it begins at 3.254 at A1, rises slightly to 3.278 at A2, dips to 3.179 at B1, increases to 3.235 at B2, continues rising to 3.304 at C1, then to 3.420 at C2, and reaches its highest value of 3.685 at 母语, showing a generally gradual upward trend with a slight dip at B1. The blue line with asterisk-shaped markers represents 随机网络; it starts at 4.189 at A1, increases slightly to 4.233 at A2, drops to 4.030 at B1, rises to 4.188 at B2, continues to 4.265 at C1, increases more steeply to 4.613 at C2, and reaches its peak of 5.204 at 母语, exhibiting a similar dip at B1 followed by a pronounced upward trajectory in the later categories. Both lines follow roughly parallel trajectories across the x-axis categories, with the blue line consistently positioned above the red line throughout the entire plot.
